content.short: IDRX is a regulated stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Indonesian rupiah.
content.description: IDRX is an Indonesian rupiah stablecoin, pegged 1:1 and redeemable for rupiah, built for fast global transfers, digital payments and round-the-clock access to financial markets. CoinGecko includes IDRX in its World Chain ecosystem category.
